sourceClassification: Already exposed, fully specified repository fixtures; not unseen textbooks, independent LLM interpretation or teacher effectiveness evidence
scope: Three different native optical families; existing qualified scene bundles, observations, result-aware Fit and browser UI. No production edits.

whatIf.classification: teacher-authored physical hypothetical, not original source given

teachingPrompts: Identify the explicit source, ideal-lens and passive-detector geometry, mm and x-right/y-up.
Separate a conditional analytical ideal-image coordinate from sampled native detector crossings and relative power (not watts).
Change only lens-1 focalLength 100 to 150 mm as a teacher hypothetical; use Fit; inspect geometry and measured/predicted differences without treating a detector count as an image.

whatIf.classification: teacher-authored physical hypothetical, not original source given

teachingPrompts: Identify the finite two-sided mirror and directional source; distinguish its supporting-line virtual image from native sampled reflected rays.
Explain why native reflection counts and passive detector crossings do not identify a complete per-source ray path or physical image.
Change only source-1 y from 30 to 40 mm, preserve the source baseline and compare the current native result and conditional image without asserting every emitted ray hit the mirror.

whatIf.classification: teacher-authored physical hypothetical, not original source given

teachingPrompts: Identify authored four-face convex glass, explicit indices and the explicit Fresnel-off transmitted-only approximation; do not infer 3D material behavior.
Separate recorded first-face native encounters from a complete ray history; recognize optional finite-hit numerical diagnostic as NONCERTIFYING and an ideal-image request here as unavailable.
Change only S1 directionDeg from 0 to 5 degrees away from normal incidence, comparing observations without claiming exact-critical physics or upgrading any inconsistent/unknown numerical advisory.

sharedQuestions: Which values are originally source-given, versus an explicitly labelled teacher intervention?
Which displayed results are finite sampled native observations, which are conditional analytical model values, and which are unavailable/suppressed?
What cannot be concluded about continuous illumination, ray lineage, physical images, absolute watts and source interpretation?
Can a reader locate the source, canonical current status, intervention history, requested-result limitation and Fit without reading raw JSON?

humanReview.participantTarget: at least two consenting actual teachers, not recruited or simulated by software
humanReview.privacy: Keep participant identities and raw private feedback out of public repository and Actions artifacts.
humanReview.interpretationFidelity: known source fixture field retention, not unfamiliar question interpretation
humanReview.physicalCorrectness: separate native software checks, not guaranteed real-world optical truth

noChanges: Do not patch pinned PhyDemo ray tracer, numerical tolerance, native seed policy, source schema or canonical accepted measurements.
Never infer a textbook answer or recast a teacher hypothetical as an original source fact.
Do not merge research-only PR92-99 workflows or reuse critical-angle research cases as classroom physics ground truth.
No teacher/student effectiveness claim from CI, screenshots or same-assistant review.
